title: Pipeline (pipeline.json)
description: The parts of a pipeline, where each sits in the yard, and the joins between them.

key.description: The short name of the part. It names the folder parts/<key>/ and is what CJ.bay(key) takes.

artifact.description: The id of the artifact this part was copied from.

bay.description: The top-left corner of the part's bay in the yard's world, [x, y].

scale.description: How much the part's 1920 x 1080 sheet is shrunk.

kind.description: call, message, queue, write, read, http, rpc, event or file

symbol.description: The symbol the work crosses at, as written in the source.

carries.description: The unit of work that crosses.

reason.description: Why these two ports are joined.
